interview_question: How would you design a distributed rate limiter that handles 100,000 requests per second across multiple data centers?
expected_answer: A distributed rate limiter can be implemented using the Token Bucket or Sliding Window Log algorithm stored in a Redis cluster. To handle high request throughput across multi-regions, local in-memory batching with eventual consistency or atomic Redis Lua scripts can be utilized...
evaluation_criteria: Understanding of distributed locking, Redis memory constraints, latency trade-offs, fallback mechanics.
